predictions: P-A (hard-to-soft evolution, literature-anchored, falsifiable): Konus GCN 12078 states 'a hard-to-soft spectral evolution is noticeable in the course of the event'. Predict the nuFnu peak energy of the AIC-winning model DECREASES MONOTONICALLY across our blocks, first-to-last ratio >= 3. FALSIFIED if any interior block's Ep exceeds the preceding block's by more than 1 sigma, or if Ep(first)/Ep(last) < 3. [archival: 620 -> 455 -> 205 -> 113 keV, ratio 5.5, monotonic]

P-B (blackbody / union rule, falsifiable): predict the union rule fires in EXACTLY 1-2 time-resolved blocks, every firing block lying inside [0, +40] s (the peak region), with kT in 15-40 keV. FALSIFIED if zero blocks fire, if >= 3 fire, if a firing block lies wholly outside [0, +40] s, or if any firing kT < 10 or > 60 keV. NOTE: no published BB/photosphere claim exists for this burst, so a firing is an UNPUBLISHED DECISION to be scored against the expert band, never a literature reconciliation.

P-B2 (baseline-dependence, falsifiable, T8): predict the CPL+BB pair fires at least as often as the Band+BB pair (LRT_CPLBB_CPL >= LRT_BANDBB_BAND in the window-integrated row), i.e. the BB verdict remains baseline-dependent under the new engine. FALSIFIED if Band+BB fires in a block where CPL+BB does not. Any reported BB margin must name its baseline.

FALSIFIED by any block with dAIC(best_single_break - DSBPL) >= 10 AND DSBPL alpha1 not at a bound AND xb separated from kT by more than the L25 degeneracy band.
